title: FAI_WinOP app catalog
description: DOCUMENTATION / editor support. The real validation is in src/Core/AppCatalog.ps1 (Get-FaiAppCatalogError). Field names are kept identical in both (checked by tests/Unit/Apps.Tests.ps1).

id.description: Short name used in profiles; becomes the app.<id> tweak in the engine.

appxNames.description: The app's Appx (MSIX) package names: as long as the app is in the profile, bloat.remove / bloat.persistence do not touch them.

quietUninstall.description: Silent uninstaller to run instead of winget on revert (for installers whose uninstall entry has no silent command: Steam).

removeAutostart.description: Turn off autostart the way Task Manager does (StartupApproved). keepAutostart in the profile disables this.

startupRegistryNames.description: Run value names (-like pattern; a name without wildcards is turned off in advance).

startupFolderNames.description: Shortcut names in the Startup folder.

startupTaskNames.description: Paths of scheduled tasks that start the app at sign-in.

removeDesktopShortcut.description: Delete the shortcuts the installer added to the desktop, and desktopShortcutNames.

flattenStartMenu.description: Move the shortcuts in the startMenuFolders folders to the Programs root.
